name: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231
group_note: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231 -- a later, more heavily modified 夕阳再现 build (custom wiz tiers up to (boss)/(ceo), an extra 11-element magic-affinity selection step after gift-stat acceptance, multi-port ZMud/ToMud selection). WASM pass found and fixed 4 genuine compile-breaking bugs (none previously seen in this session's other 夕阳再现-family libs): (1) adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc has REAL, un-gutted socket_create()/socket_bind() calls (unlike siblings where this file was already a no-op stub) and is actually runtime-loaded via a direct DNS_MASTER->query_doing_end() call from logind.lpc's logon() (not just preloaded) -- confirmed 29 external callers (genuinely multi-purpose per AGENTS.md §7.52's exception), so only startup_udp()/send_udp() were gutted plus one stray socket_close() in send_shutdown(), not the whole file. (2) adm/daemons/network/server_2000.lpc, a fully self-contained socket-based file-transfer server (TCP listen/accept/connect, ~15 socket_* calls) with only one caller (a wizard-only cmds/bos/send_file3.lpc command) -- disabled entirely by commenting it out of adm/etc/preload rather than gutting (matches the standalone-daemon pattern; the file itself is untouched since disabling preload is sufficient, no other code path loads it). (3) adm/daemons/teamd.lpc called a completely undefined function count(count(v,"*",lvl),"/",max_lvl) (presumably meant to compute v*lvl/max_lvl via a string-based operator-dispatch helper that was never actually defined anywhere in this mudlib) -- a genuine pre-existing bug that would fail to compile natively too, not WASM-specific; fixed to direct arithmetic 'v * lvl / max_lvl'. (4) The standard §8.1 check_legal_name() i%2 parity gate/[i..<0] suffix slice (is_chinese() itself already correct) fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i], plus master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() missing a 'user == this_object()' short-circuit (added alongside this lib's own partial previous_object()-based guard). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's custom tier ladder goes up to (boss)/(ceo) above (admin); used the project-standard (admin) tier for consistency rather than the highest available tier). Registration verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y (confirm new character) -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> gift-stat menu (0 for random, y to accept) -> magic-affinity selection (0-10, used 0) -> email -> gender (m/f) -> enters world, full score sheet clean. Admin permission confirmed via '★ 您目前的权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 15146 .lpc files (15015 written, 92 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted -- the messiest codebase in this batch -- 39 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits; 6 case-label-with-trailing-comment hits (ftpd.lpc, master.lpc x2 copies, u/wenwu/securd.lpc, the 2 usual dead bakcmds copies) all diff-reviewed clean including one pre-existing duplicate-case-label quirk in master.lpc (harmless, not formatter-introduced). Post-formatter re-verified clean, admin permission still (admin).
